key_findings.finding: Sampling overwrite and FIFO queue semantics differ; the paper explicitly defers SAP extension to future work.
Node lookup and callback invocation are not proof of all-VarBind SET validation/atomic commit. Figures separate parsing, buffering, MIB operations and response handling.
Section 6.1 is primarily UI, MIB-browsing and alarm demonstrations, not a quantitative SNMP atomicity/burst/FPGA timing suite.
Command/response, independent expected payload/order/counters, negative/boundary/recovery scenarios and versioned case-level reports are directly useful verification methods.
Visual check confirms 100 8K messages versus +60 frames in Table 3-4, and frame/payload naming inconsistencies in Table 3-7. Re-derive counts and lengths before making an oracle.
RTC progression tests do not quantify 1 us accuracy; automated/manual efficiency comparison excluded reliability testing and is not universal protocol coverage.
TFTP is a component of the larger loading workflow, not evidence of a complete ARINC615A implementation.
